blocks.text: This chapter introduced the essential aspects of software development: the fundamental concepts and key terminology and the stages of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). It explored software development methodologies, including the Waterfall model and Agile, and how to plan and manage a software project. It covered quality assurance, the use of UML for graphical representation and the importance of design patterns, and finally debugging techniques, testing strategies and the software development tools that help produce high-quality software.
